components.swiftui: `Button` with `.odsProminentButton()` for accent (`.odsProminentButton(.glass)` for the glass style), `.bordered` for primary
components.note: Tertiary and text-only: `.borderless` / `TextButton`. On Apple, apply `.odsProminentButton()` to every prominent button. Under `odsTheme` the label of a `.borderedProminent` or `.glassProminent` button takes `text.primary`, not the system white, which is below 4.5:1 on the accent in default dark, forest light, forest dark, clay dark, indigo light, indigo dark, wine light, wine dark. In forest light it is the same color as the fill, so the label cannot be seen. The modifier keeps the system style and sets the label to `accent.contrast`. Compose needs nothing: `onPrimary` is `accent.contrast`.
